name: careerpilot-ai
description: Personal job-hunting agent with a human in the loop

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npx --prefix server playwright install chromium && npm run db:up && npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
